subject: MAP: Security acceptance anchors, DPA redline owner, and data retention plan
messages:
From: Alan Cho <alan.cho@midstreambank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@midstreambank.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2024 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG scope question

Hi Kimberly & Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looks promising. We want to start a mutual action plan (MAP) next week focused on security gating for our procurement committee. High level asks from our side:

- SOC 2 attestation copy (latest) + any gap remediation timeline if not yet in scope.
- SIG/CAIQ matrix mapped to your hosted vs private deployment options.
- Proposed DPA (we have redlines) and clarity on data retention windows for logs / customer data.

Can you share an initial MAP with owners, milestones, and dates? Our target decision window is August 15 (internal board approval). If possible, include the acceptance criteria per gate so our security team can sign off.

Priya (cc) will own the compliance side; Alan is procurement.

Best,
Alan

--
Alan Cho
Director, Procurement 
Midstream Bank
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Alan Cho <alan.cho@midstreambank.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@midstreambank.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2024 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG scope question

Alan — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to run a focused MAP to hit your Aug 15 decision window. Draft plan attached (MAP_midstream_v1.xlsx) and a SIG snapshot (SIG_matrix_midstream.pdf). High-level plan below: 

1) Intake & baseline (this week) — assign owners, confirm acceptance criteria (SOC 2 / SIG maps) — owner: Kimberly (Redwood) / Priya (Midstream) — target: 2024-07-05
2) Evidence sprint (two weeks) — SOC 2 artifacts, CAIQ exports, configuration docs — owners: Marcus (Redwood SEC) + Midstream SME — target: 2024-07-19
3) DPA negotiation + data retention carveouts — legal owners: Jordan (Redwood Legal) + Midstream Legal — target: 2024-07-26
4) Final security review & signoff — security runbook staging and acceptance testing on a private deployment (if required) — target: 2024-08-07
5) Board/Procurement decision — target: 2024-08-15

Notes / clarifications: 
- SOC 2: we can provide our latest Type II report (2023) and a gap table for controls added since then.
- SIG/CAIQ: the attached matrix maps our hosted API and Redwood Private variants; where we flag a difference we've added an "operational note" (e.g., key management integration differences).
- Data retention: default retention for customer data in hosted is 90 days; logs and telemetry follow a separate retention tier (90/365/720 options). We'll call out options in the MAP.

Jordan — can you own the DPA redline and push an editable draft to the folder? Marcus — can you prepare a short evidence checklist for the sprint?

Alan/Priya — please confirm the owners on your side and flag any hard blockers (e.g., EU residency requirement, escrow ask).

Thanks,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions & Security
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@midstreambank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Alan Cho <alan.cho@midstreambank.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2024 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG scope question

Kimberly — thanks, this looks like a great starting point. Quick clarifications from our security team: 

- We need the SOC 2 Type II report and the control mapping to SIG (not just a CAIQ export) so our control owners can crosswalk responsibilities.
- For data residency: critical requirement is that cardholder-processing data remain in our EU region (we may request Redwood Private for that lane).
- For the DPA: our legal will circulate a redline with a standard escrow clause (we can be flexible on retention tiers but want explicit archive vs deletion semantics).

Owners on our side: Priya (Compliance), Arjun Patel (Security), and Meera Singh (Legal) — I'll add them to the MAP once they confirm availability.

Two asks for Redwood to include in the MAP docs: a) a concise "control acceptance matrix" (who provides evidence vs what Redwood certifies), and b) a short runbook for how rollback/fallback to a lower-tier model variant would be handled operationally during onboarding.

We'll review the attachments and circle back by EOD Thursday.

— Priya

Priya Rao
VP, Compliance
Midstream Bank
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@midstreambank.com>, Alan Cho <alan.cho@midstreambank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2024 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG scope question

Thanks Priya — we've uploaded an editable DPA redline (DPA_redline_v2.docx) to the drive link and aligned a first pass of the control acceptance matrix inside MAP_midstream_v1.xlsx. A few notes for legal alignment:

- We can accept narrow EU residency carveouts via Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC). For hosted, we can offer regional processing but not a hard deletion escrow unless we go to a Reserved/Private contract with customized terms.
- Retention semantics: we'll enumerate retention buckets explicitly (session tokens/logs: 90d; analytics pseudo-IDs: 365d; long-term audit logs: 720d) and provide a process for export+deletion on contract termination.
- SIG specifics: where a control maps to customer responsibility (e.g., customer-managed KMS) we've added an explicit callout in the matrix.

Marcus — can you attach the evidence checklist and the SOC 2 inventory exports to the folder by EOD? Rachel — please prepare the staging test plan (private deployment) so we can estimate effort.

Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@midstreambank.com>, Alan Cho <alan.cho@midstreambank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2024 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG scope question

Priya/Alan — attaching the evidence checklist and short SOC 2 artifact index to the shared folder (evidence_checklist_midstream.pdf). Quick operational notes: 

- Evidence sprint: expect ~5 owner-required items (configuration exports, access lists, change logs, incident response runbook, and SOC 2 report). We'll schedule daily 30-min standups during the sprint.
- If Midstream wants a private deployment for EU-card data, estimated staging window is two weeks (provisioning + smoke tests). Cost/lead time in MAP spreadsheet.
- If there's urgency on the DPA escrow language, Jordan and I can take the first redline pass and schedule a brief sync with Midstream legal Friday.

Looking forward to the sprint — will update the MAP worksheet with dates after we confirm your internal owners.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
